lines: #Most people ask, what do I want *today?*
The wealthy ask, where do I want to be in ten *years?*
Why they buy fewer things but better *things.*
Why they're calm when everyone else *panics.*
#When you think in days, every bad day feels like the *end.*
When you think in years, it's just a *blip.*
Picture your life ten years from *now.*
Then ask, what would that person want me to do *today?*
#Little choices, pointed in the right direction, for a long *time.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: The Rich Think in Years, Not Days
post.caption: Short-term thinking feels good. Long-term thinking pays. 📈
post.first_comment: Where do you want to be in 10 years? 👇
